note.item: Requires Joomla 5.4 or newer (or Joomla 6) and PHP 8.1 or newer.

addition.item: Image source option: pick images one by one, or show the images from a folder below /images (max. 30).
Alternative text and a "decorative image" option for each image.
Stop/start button for the ribbon when Autoplay is on.
Arrow keys scroll the ribbon; trackpads and touch screens can swipe it on wide screens.
The module class suffix is now applied.

change.item: Ribbon photos are buttons that can be opened with the keyboard and have an accessible name; focus returns to the photo when the slideshow closes.
Ribbon photos are real images instead of CSS backgrounds, with width/height and lazy loading.
Nothing moves unless Autoplay is on; the large slideshow never plays by itself. Autoplay also runs on phones and respects "reduce motion".
The slideshow has an accessible name, labelled indicators and translated button labels.
The ribbon adapts when the window is resized or a tablet is rotated.
Modern installer script; assets are registered in joomla.asset.json.
Update server, download and changelog URLs point at TLWebdesignNL/Pretty-PhotoRibbon.

fix.item: Ribbon arrows did nothing on screens below 768 px.
A JavaScript error on small screens stopped further ribbons on the page from working.
The module renders nothing instead of an empty carousel when no images are available.
Absolute image URLs are no longer prefixed with the site URL.
The default aspect ratio (4x3) is now a valid option.
The update server offers updates on Joomla 6.

security.item: Image URLs, alt texts and layout settings are escaped in the output; the ratio and number of visible images are validated.

language.item: Dutch description corrected, unused strings removed, spelling fixed.

addition.item: Introduced configurable autoplay behaviour for the ribbon carousel.
Published a changelog file for the module package.

change.item: Raised the maximum number of ribbon images from 20 to 30.
Aligned the module dispatcher and helper factories with the TLWeb namespace structure.

fix.item: General stability improvements and dependency updates.
Resolved issues reported after the initial Joomla 4 release.

addition.item: First public version of Pretty PhotoRibbon for Joomla.
